subject: Issue with invoice VEN026-0023
body:
Dear Lotus Industries Pvt Ltd team,

We are reconciling purchases with GSTR-2B and found a discrepancy for invoice VEN026-0023 dated 11 Sep 2025. The supplier’s GSTR-2B line shows tax Rs 56,512 while the invoice shows Rs 61,803. Only the lower amount can be claimed. Rs 5,291 of input tax credit depends on this. Please amend your return or correct the booking and confirm once done.

Accounts team
Sharma Traders Pvt Ltd
GSTIN 07AAACS1234F1ZU
